title_zh: 亞什特 第 9 首‧德爾瓦斯帕讚（牲畜守護讚）
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 23 卷，1883；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
(pa nãm i ýazdã, hôrmezd i hvadâe
i awazûnî gurz hvarahe awazâyât,
gêush urve darvâsp hvarahe bê rasât,
 ezh hamâ gunâh ... pa patit hôm!) 
xshnaothra ahurahe mazdå , tarôidîti angrahe
mainyêush, haithyâvarshtãm hyat vasnâ
ferashôtemem. staomî ashem,
ashem vohû...(3).
fravarâne mazdayasnô zarathushtrish vîdaêvô
ahura-tkaêshô,
 (Here recite the appropriate Gah dedication.)
segments.en:
May Ahura Mazda be rejoiced! May Angra Mainyu be afflicted!....
Ashem Vohu: Holiness is the best of all good....
I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathushtra,
one who hates the Daevas and obeys the laws of Ahura;
For sacrifice, prayer, satisfaction, and glorification unto Havani,
the holy and master of holiness.
Unto the powerful Drvaspa, made by Mazda and holy,
Be propitiation, with sacrifice, prayer, propitiation, and glorification.
Yatha ahu vairyo: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness....
 [1]
segments.zh:
願阿胡拉‧馬茲達喜樂! 願安格拉‧曼紐受苦!....
阿舍姆‧沃胡: 聖潔是一切善事中最好的....
我自認是馬茲達的崇拜者, 查拉圖斯特拉的追隨者,
誰憎惡達埃瓦並遵守阿胡拉的律法;
為獻祭, 祈禱, 滿足及讚美哈瓦尼,
聖潔者且為聖潔之主.
歸於強大的德爾瓦斯帕，由馬茲達所造且聖潔的，
成為贖罪，伴隨著祭祀、禱告、贖罪和讚美。
Yatha ahu vairyo: 主的意志是聖潔的律法....
[1]

segments.orig:
drvâspãm sûrãm mazdadhâtãm
ashaonîm ýazamaide drvô-pasvãm drvô-staorãm
drvô-urvathãm drvô- aperenâyukãm
pouru-spaxshti dûrât pithana hvâthravana darekhô-haxedhrayana
segments.en:
We sacrifice unto the powerful Drvaspa, made by Mazda and
holy, who heeps the flocks in health, the herds in health, the
grown-up (cattle) in health, the young ones in health; who watches
well from afar, with a wide-spread and long-continued welfare-giving
friendship;
segments.zh: 我們獻祭給強大的德爾瓦斯帕，由馬茲達所造且聖潔，他使羊群健康，使牛群健康，使成年（牛）健康，使幼獸健康；他從遠方良好地守望，擁有廣泛且持續長久的福祉友誼；

segments.orig:
ýuxta-aspãm varetô-rathãm
hvanat-caxrãm fshaonîm marezãm amavaitîm
huraodhãm hvâsaokãm baêshazyãm
drvô-stâitîm drvô- varetãm
avanghe narãm ashaonãm.
segments.en:
Who yokes teams of horses, who makes her chariot turn and
its wheels sound, fat and glistening, strong, tall-formed, weal-possessing,
health-giving, powerful to stand and powerful to turn for assistance
to the faithful.
segments.zh: 誰將馬匹編成隊，誰使她的戰車轉動且車輪鳴響，肥壯且閃閃發光，強壯，身形高大，具福祉，賜予健康，有力站立，有力轉向以協助忠誠者。

segments.orig:
tãm ýazata
haoshyanghô paradhâtô
upa upa-bdi harayå berezô
srîrayå mazdadhâtayå satem aspanãm
hazangrem gavãm baêvare anumayanãm uta zaothrãm
frabarô,
segments.en:
To her did Haoshyangha, the Paradhata, offer up a sacrifice
on the enclosure of the Hara, the beautiful height, made by Mazda,
with a hundred male horses, a thousand oxen, and ten thousand
lambs, and with an offering of libations:
segments.zh: 獻給她的是，浩尚陽哈，即帕拉哈塔，在哈拉的圍欄上獻上祭祀，哈拉是美麗的高地，由馬茲達所造，並有百匹雄馬，千頭牛，萬隻羔羊，以及奠祭的供獻：

segments.orig:
dazdi-mê vanguhi sevishte
drvâspe tat âyaptem
ýat bavâni aiwi-vanyå
vîspe daêva mâzanya
ýatha azem nôit tarshtô frâ-nmâne
thwaêshât parô daêvaêibyô
frâ ahmât parô vîspe daêva
anusô tarshta nemåñte
tarshta temanghô dvâråñte.
segments.en:
'Grant me this boon, O good, most beneficent Drvaspa! that
I may overcome all the Daevas of Mazana; that I may never fear
and bow through terror before the Daevas, but that all the Daevas
may fear and bow in spite of themselves before me, that they may
fear and flee down to darkness.'
segments.zh: '賜予我這個恩典，哦良善且最有益的德爾瓦斯帕！使我能克服瑪扎納的所有達埃瓦；使我永不因恐懼而在達埃瓦前害怕並屈膝，但願所有達埃瓦尽管自己不願也會在我面前害怕並屈膝，使他們害怕並逃向黑暗。'

segments.orig:
dathat ahmâi tat avat âyaptem drvâspa sûra
mazdadhâta ashaoni thrâthri zaothrô-barâi
aredrâi ýazemnâi
jaidhyañtâi dâthrish âyaptem.
segments.en:
The powerful Drvaspa, made by Mazda, the holy Drvaspa, the
maintainer, granted him that boon, as he was offering libations,
giving gifts, sacrificing, and entreating that she would grant
him that boon.
segments.zh: 強大的德爾瓦斯帕，由馬茲達所造，聖潔的德爾瓦斯帕，維持者，授予他這個恩典，因為他在獻奠祭，獻禮物，獻祭，並懇求她授予他這個恩典。

segments.orig:
ahe raya hvarenanghaca
tãm ýazâi surunvata ýasna
tãm ýazâi huyashta ýasna
drvâspãm sûrãm mazdadhâtãm
ashaonîm zaothrâbyô,
drvâspãm sûrãm mazdadhâtãm
ashaonîm ýazamaide
haomayô gava baresmana, hizvô danghangha mãthraca,
vacaca shyaothnaca zaothrâbyasca, arshuxdhaêibyasca
vâkhzhibyô.
ýenghê hâtãm âat ýesnê
paitî vanghô mazdå ahurô vaêthâ
ashât hacâ ýånghãmcâ tãscâ
tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
For her brightness and glory, I will offer her a sacrifice
worth being heard; I will offer her a sacrifice well performed,
namely, unto the powerful Drvaspa, made by Mazda and holy. We
offer up libations to the powerful Drvaspa, made by Mazda and
holy; we offer her the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom
of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations,
and the rightly-spoken words.
Yenghe hatam: All those beings of whom Ahura Mazda....
 [2]
segments.zh:
為她的光榮與榮耀，我將獻上值得被聽見的祭祀；我將獻上執行得當的祭祀，也就是獻給強大的德爾瓦斯帕，由馬茲達所造且聖潔。我們向強大的德爾瓦斯帕，由馬茲達所造且聖潔，獻上奠祭；我們獻給她豪麻與肉、巴爾斯瑪、舌之智慧、聖咒、言語、行為、奠祭，以及正確說出的話語。
英格赫哈塔姆: 所有被阿胡拉‧馬茲達所.... [2]

segments.orig:
drvâspãm ... avanghe narãm ashaonãm.
(Repeat verses 1-2.)
segments.en:
We offer up a sacrifice unto the powerful Drvaspa, made by
Mazda and holy, who keeps the flocks in health....
Who yokes teams of horses .... for assistance to the faithful.
segments.zh:
我們向強大的德爾瓦斯帕，由馬茲達所造且聖潔，獻上祭祀，他使羊群健康....
誰將馬匹編成隊 .... 以協助忠誠者。

segments.orig:
tãm ýazata
ýô ýimô xshaêtô hvãthwô
hukairyât haca barezanghat satem aspanãm hazangrem
gavãm baêvare anumayanãm uta zaothrãm
frabarô,
segments.en:
To her did Yima Khshaeta, the good shepherd, offer up a sacrifice
from the height Hukairya, with a hundred male horses, a thousand
oxen, ten thousand lambs, and with an offering of libations:
segments.zh: 獻給她的是，伊瑪‧赫沙埃塔，良善的牧羊人，從胡凱里亞高地獻上祭祀，有百匹雄馬，千頭牛，萬隻羔羊，以及奠祭的供獻：

segments.orig:
dazdi-mê vanguhi sevishte
drvâspe tat âyaptem
ýatha azem fshaoni vãthwa
ava-barâni avi mazdå dâmabyô
ýatha azem amerextîm
avi-barâni avi mazdå dâmabyô,
segments.zh: 「請賜予我這個恩惠啊，善良、最仁慈的德爾瓦斯帕！願我能將豐饒與畜群帶到馬茲達所造的世界；願我能將不朽帶到馬茲達所造的世界；

segments.orig:
uta azem apa-barâni
va shudhemca tarshnemca
haca mazdå dâmabyô
uta azem apa-barâni
va zaourvãmca merethyûmca
haca mazdå dâmabyô
uta azem apa-barâni
va garememca vâtem aotemca
haca mazdå dâmabyô
hazangrem aiwi-gâmanãm.
segments.en:
'That I may take away both hunger and thirst, from the world
created by Mazda; that I may take away both old age and death,
from the world created by Mazda; that I may take away both hot
wind and cold wind, from the world created by Mazda, for a thousand
years.'
segments.zh: 「願我能從馬茲達所造的世界帶走飢餓與口渴；願我能從馬茲達所造的世界帶走衰老與死亡；願我能從馬茲達所造的世界帶走熱風與冷風，持續一千年。」

segments.orig:

6.)

 [3]

強大的德爾瓦斯帕，馬茲達所造，神聖的德爾瓦斯帕，守護者，應允了他那個恩惠，因他正獻上澆祭、奉上禮物、祭祀，並懇求她賜予他那個恩惠。

她為信者的援助套上馬匹的車乘……

segments.orig:
tãm ýazata
vîsô puthrô âthwyânôish
vîsô sûrayå thraêtaonô
upa varenem cathru-gaoshem satem aspanãm hazangrem gavãm
baêvare anumayanãm uta zaothrãm frabarô,
segments.en:
To her did Thraetaona, the heir of the valiant Athwya clan,
offer up a sacrifice in the four-cornered Varena, with a hundred
male horses, a thousand oxen, ten thousand lambs, and with an
offering of libations:
segments.zh: 斯拉埃陶納，英勇的阿特維亞氏族之嗣，在四角的瓦雷納向她獻上祭祀，以一百匹公馬、一千頭牛、一萬隻羔羊，並以澆祭為供品：

segments.orig:
dazdi-mê vanguhi sevishte
drvâspe tat âyaptem
ýat bavâni aiwi-vanyå azhîm dahâkem
thrizafanem thrikameredhem xshvash-ashîm hazangrâ-ýaoxshtîm
ashaojanghem daêvîm drujem akhem gaêthâvyô
drvañtem ýãm ashaojastemãm drujem
fraca kereñtat angrô mainyush aoi ýãm
astvaitîm gaêthãm mahrkâi ashahe gaêthanãm,
uta-hê vañta azâni
sanghavâci arenavâci
ýôi hen kehrpa sraêshta zazâtêe
gaêthyâi tê ýôi abdôteme.
segments.en:
'Grant me this boon, O good, most beneficent Drvaspa! that
I may overcome Azhi Dahaka, the three-mouthed, the three-headed,
the six-eyed, who has a thousand senses, that most powerful, fiendish
Druj, that demon, baleful to the world, the strongest Druj that
Angra Mainyu created against the material world, to destroy the
world of the good principle; and that I may deliver his two wives,
Savanghavack and Erenavach, who are the fairest of body amongst
women, and the most wonderful creatures in the world.'
segments.zh:
賜予我這個恩典，啊，良善且最有恩惠的德爾瓦斯帕！ 那
我可以戰勝阿日‧達哈卡，三張嘴的，三個頭的，
六隻眼睛的，擁有千種感官的，那最強大的，邪惡的
德魯格，那個惡魔，對世界有害的，最強的德魯格 那
安格拉‧曼紐創造來對抗物質世界，以毀滅那
善良原則的世界；以及我可以救出他的兩位妻子，
薩萬哈瓦克和艾雷納瓦赫，誰是身體最美麗的，在
女性，以及世界上最奇妙的生物。

segments.orig:
dathat ahmâi ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
(Repeat verses 5-6).
segments.en:
The powerful Drvaspa, made by Mazda, the holy Drvasya, the
maintainer, granted him that boon, as he was offering up libations,

him that boon.
For her brightness and glory, I will offer her a sacrifice worth
being heard....
 [4]

她為信者的援助套上馬匹的車乘……

segments.orig:
tãm ýazata
haomô frâshmish baêshazyô
srîrô xshathryô zairi-dôithrô
barezishte paiti barezahi
haraithyô paiti barezayå, âat hîm jaidhyat
avat âyaptem,
segments.en:
To her did Haoma offer up a sacrifice, Haoma, the enlivening,
the healing, the beautiful, the lordly, with golden eyes, upon
the highest height of the Haraiti Bareza. He begged of her a boon
saying:
segments.zh: 豪麻向她獻上祭祀，豪麻，賦予生機者、治癒者、俊美者、威嚴者，生有金眸，在哈賴提‧巴雷扎的最高峰上。他向她祈求一個恩惠，說道：

segments.orig:
dazdi-mê vanguhi sevishte
drvâspe tat âyaptem
ýatha azem bañdayeni
mairîm tûirîm frangrasyânem
uta bastem vâdhayeni
uta bastem upanayeni bastem kavôish haosravanghahe
janât tem kava haosrava
pasne varôish caêcastahe
jafrahe uruyâpahe
puthrô kaêna syâvarshânâi
zûrô-jatahe narahe
akhraêrathaheca naravahe.
segments.en:
'Grant me this boon, O good, most beneficent Drvaspa! that
I may bind the Turanian murderer Franghrasyan, that I may drag
him bound, that may bring him bound unto king Husravah, that king
Husravah may kill him, behind the Chaechasta lake, the deep lake
of salt waters, to avenge the murder of his father Syavarshana,
a man, and of Aghraeratha, a semi-man.'
segments.zh: 「請賜予我這個恩惠，啊，善良的、最仁慈的德爾瓦斯帕！願我能捆綁圖蘭兇手弗蘭格拉西揚，願我能將他捆綁著拖來，願我能將他捆綁著帶到胡斯拉瓦國王面前，願胡斯拉瓦國王能在察埃查斯塔湖——那深深的鹹水湖——後面殺死他，以報他父親斯亞瓦爾沙納（一個男子）和阿格拉埃拉薩（一個半人）被殺之仇。」

由馬茲達所造的、強大的德爾瓦斯帕，神聖的德爾瓦斯帕，那位維護者，在他獻上奠酒、奉上禮物、祭祀並懇求她賜予他那個恩惠時，將那個恩惠賜予了他。
為了她的光明與榮耀，我將向她奉上值得聆聽的祭祀……

我們向由馬茲達所造的、神聖的、強大的德爾瓦斯帕奉上祭祀，她使畜群保持健康……
她為信者的援助而套上馬匹的車乘……

segments.orig:
tãm ýazata
arsha airyanãm dah'yunãm
xshathrâi hañkeremô haosrava
pasne varôish caêcastahe
jafrahe urvyâpahe satem aspanãm hazangrem gavãm
baêvare anumayanãm uta zaothrãm frabarô,
segments.en:
To her did the gallant Husravah, he who united the Arya nations
into one kingdom, offer up a sacrifice, behind the Chaechasta
lake, the deep lake of salt waters, with a hundred male horses,
a thousand oxen, ten thousand lambs, and an offering of libations:
segments.zh: 英勇的胡斯拉瓦，那位將雅利安諸族統一為一個王國的君王，在察埃查斯塔湖——那深深的鹹水湖——後面，向她獻上祭祀：一百匹公馬、一千頭牛、一萬隻羊羔，以及奠酒之祭：

segments.orig:
dazdi-mê vanguhi sevishte
drvâspe tat âyaptem
ýatha azem nijanâni
mairîm tûirîm frangrasyânem
pasne varôish caêcastahe
jafrahe urvyâpahe
puthrô kaêna syâvarshânâi
zûrô-jatahe narahe akhraêrathaheca naravahe.
segments.en:
'Grant me this boon, O good, most beneficent Drvaspa! that
I may kill the Turanian murderer, Franghrasyan, behind the Chaechasta
lake, the deep lake of salt waters, to avenge the murder of my
father Syavarshana, a man, and of Aghraeratha, a semi-man.'
segments.zh: 「請賜予我這個恩惠，啊，善良的、最仁慈的德爾瓦斯帕！願我能殺死圖蘭兇手弗蘭格拉西揚，在察埃查斯塔湖——那深深的鹹水湖——後面，以報我父親斯亞瓦爾沙納（一個男子）和阿格拉埃拉薩（一個半人）被殺之仇。」

 [6]
segments.zh:
由馬茲達所造的、強大的德爾瓦斯帕，神聖的德爾瓦斯帕，那位維護者，在他獻上奠酒、奉上禮物、祭祀並懇求她賜予他那個恩惠時，將那個恩惠賜予了他。
為了她的光明與榮耀，我將向她奉上值得聆聽的祭祀……

segments.orig:
drvâspãm ... avanghe narãm ashaonãm.
(Repeat verses 1-2.)
segments.en:
We offer up a sacrifice unlo the powerful Drvaspa, made by
Mazda and holy, who keeps the flocks in health....
Who yokes teams of horses .... for assistance to the faithful,
segments.zh:
我們向由馬茲達所造的、神聖的、強大的德爾瓦斯帕奉上祭祀，她使畜群保持健康……
她為信者的援助而套上馬匹的車乘……

segments.orig:
tãm ýazata
ýô ashava zarathushtrô airyene vaêjahi
vanghuyå dâityayå
haomayô gava baresmana, hizvô danghangha mãthraca,
vacaca shyaothnaca zaothrâbyasca, arshuxdhaêibyasca
vâkhzhibyô, âat hîm jaidhyat avat âyaptem,
segments.en:
To her did the holy Zarathushtra offer up a sacrifice in the
Airyana Vaejah, by the good river Daitya, with the Haoma and meat,
with the baresma, with the wisdom of the tongue, with the holy
spells, with the speech, with the deeds, with the libations, and
with the rightly-spoken words. He begged of her a boon, saying:
segments.zh: 神聖的查拉圖斯特拉在艾里亞納‧瓦埃賈，在善良的戴提亞河畔，以豪麻與肉、以巴爾斯曼枝、以舌頭的智慧、以神聖的咒語、以言語、以行為、以奠酒，並以正確說出的話語，向她獻上祭祀。他向她祈求一個恩惠，說道：

segments.orig:
dazdi-mê vanguhi sevishte
drvâspe tat âyaptem
ýatha azem hâcayene
vanguhîm âzâtãm hutaosãm
anumatêe daênayâi
anûxtêe daênayâi
anu-varshtêe daênayâi
ýâ-mê daênãm mâzdayasnîm
zrasca dât apica aotât
ýâ-mê varezânâi vanguhîm
dât frasastîm.
segments.en:
'O good, most beneficent Drvaspa! grant me this boon, that
I may bring the good and noble Hutaosa to think according to the
law, to speak according to the law, to do according to the law,
that she may spread my Mazdean law and make it known, and that
she may bestow beautiful praises upon my deeds.'
segments.zh: 「善良的、最慈悲的德爾瓦斯帕啊！賜予我此恩德，願我能使品德高尚的好胡塔歐莎按律法而思，按律法而言，按律法而行，使她傳播我的瑪茲達崇拜者之律法並使之廣為人知，使她對我的業績獻上美妙的讚詞。」

segments.orig:
dathat ahmâi ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
(Repeat verses 5-6.)
segments.en:
The strong Drvaspa, made by Mazda, the holy Drvaspa, the maintainer,
granted him that boon, as he was offering up libations, giving
gifts, sacrificing, and entreating that she would grant him that
boon.
For her brightness and glory, I wiII offer her a sacrifice worth
being heard....
 [7]
segments.zh: 強大的德爾瓦斯帕，由馬茲達創造，聖潔的德爾瓦斯帕，維護者，在他獻上奠祭、贈獻禮物、進行祭祀、懇求她賜予此恩德時，她就賜予他此恩德。為她的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上值得聆聽的祭祀......

segments.orig:
drvâspãm ... avanghe narãm ashaonãm.
(Repeat verses 1-2.)
segments.en:
We offer up a sacrifice unto the powerful Drvaspa, made by
Mazda and holy, who keeps the flocks in health....
Who yokes teams of horses .... for assistance to the faithful.
segments.zh: 我們向強大的德爾瓦斯帕獻上祭祀，由馬茲達創造且聖潔的德爾瓦斯帕，她保持羊群的健康......她為信徒們套上馬隊以助其戰鬥。

segments.orig:
tãm ýazata
berezaidhish kava vîshtâspô
pasne âpô dâityayå satem aspanãm
hazangrem gavãm baêvare anumayanãm uta zaothrãm
frabarô,
segments.en:
To her did the tall Kavi Vistaspa offer up a sacrifice behind
the waters of the river Daitya, with a hundred male horses, a
thousand oxen, ten thousand lambs, and with an offering of libations:
segments.zh: 高大的凱維‧維斯塔斯帕在戴提亞河水之後向她獻上了祭祀，獻上百匹公馬、千頭牛、萬隻羔羊，並獻上了奠祭：

segments.orig:
dazdi-mê vanguhi sevishte
drvâspe tat âyaptem
ýatha azâni peshana ashta aurvañtô vîspa-thaurvô
ashtôish puthrô vîspa-thaurvô urvi-xaodhô
urvi-verethrô stvî-manaothrish ýenghe hapta
sata ushtranãm jainyâvarat pasca hvîdhahe,
ýatha azâni peshana mairyehe h'yaonahe arejat-aspahe,
ýatha azâni peshana darshinikahe daêvayasnahe.
segments.en:
'Grant me this boon, O good, most beneficent Drvaspa! that
I may put to flight Ashta-aurvant, the son of Vispa-thaurvo-asti,
the all-afflicting, of the brazen helmet, of the brazen armour,
of the thick neck, behind whom seven hundred camels ....; that
I may put to flight the Hvyaona murderer, Arejat-aspa; that I
may put to flight Darshinika, the worshipper of the Daevas;
segments.zh: 「善良的、最慈悲的德爾瓦斯帕啊！賜予我此恩德，願我能擊潰阿什塔‧烏爾瓦特，維斯帕‧塔烏爾瓦阿斯提之子，全能的施苦者，銅盔者，銅甲者，厚頸者，他身後跟隨著七百駱駝......；願我能擊潰許亞歐納弒殺者阿雷賈特‧阿斯帕；願我能擊潰達爾什尼卡，達埃瓦的崇拜者；

segments.orig:
uta azem nijanâni
tãthryâvañtem duzhdaênem
uta azem nijanâi
spinjaurushem daêvayasnem,
uta azem fraourvaêsayeni
humaya varedhakanãmca
h'yaonya haca dainghâvô,
uta azem nijanâni
h'yaonînãm dah'yunãm
pañcasakhnâi satakhnâishca
satakhnâi hazangrakhnâishca
hazangrakhnâi baêvarekhnâishca
baêvarekhnâi ahãxshtakhnâishca.
segments.en:
And that I may smite Tathravant of the bad law; that I may
smite Spinjaurushka, the worshipper of the Daevas; and that I
may bring unto the good law the nations of the Varedhakas and
of the Hvyaonas; and that I may smite of the Huyaona nations their
fifties and their hundreds, their hundreds and their thousands,
their thousands and their tens of thousands, their tens of thousands
and their myriads of myriads.
segments.zh: 願我能擊碎律法不善的塔特拉瓦特；願我能擊碎斯品賈魯什卡，達埃瓦的崇拜者；願我能將瓦雷達卡民族與許亞歐納民族導向善律法；願我能擊碎許亞歐納民族的五十人隊與百人隊，百人隊與千人隊，千人隊與萬人隊，萬人隊與無數的無數。

segments.orig:
dathat ahmâi tãm avat âyaptem drvâspa
sûra mazdadhâta ashaoni thrâthri zaothrô-barâi
aredrâi ýazemnâi
jaidhyañtâi dâthrish âyaptem.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide! (Repeat verse
6.)
segments.en:
The strong Drvaspa, made by Mazda, the holy Drvaspa, the maintainer,
granted him that boon, as he was offering up libations, giving
gifts, sacrificing, and entreating that she would grant him that
boon.
For her brightness and glory, I will offer her a sacrifice worth
being heard; I will offer her a sacrifice well performed, namely,
unto the powerful Drvaspa made by Mazda and holy. We offer up
libations to the powerful Drvaspa, made by Mazda and holy; we
offer her the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue,
the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the
rightly-spoken words.
Yatha ahu vairyo: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness....
I bless the sacrifice and prayer, and the strength and vigour
of the powerful Drvaspa, made by Mazda and holy.
Ashem Vohu: Holiness is the best of all good....
[Give] unto that man brightness and glory, give him health of
body,.... give him the bright, all-happy, blissful abode of the
holy Ones.

segments.zh:
強壯的德爾瓦斯帕，由馬茲達所造，聖潔的德爾瓦斯帕，維持者，
授予他這項恩典，當他正在獻上酒祭，給予
禮物，獻祭，以及懇求她將那項恩典授予他
恩典。
為她的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上價值
被聽見；我將獻上一項執行得當的祭祀，具體來說，
給予強大的德爾瓦斯帕，由馬茲達所造且聖潔的。我們奉上
祭酒給予強大的德爾瓦斯帕，由馬茲達所造且聖潔的；我們
奉上給她豪麻和肉，巴雷斯瑪，舌頭的智慧，
聖咒，言語，行為，祭酒，和
正確說出的話。
Yatha ahu vairyo: 主的意志是神聖的律法....
我祝福祭祀與禱告，以及力量與活力
強大的 Drvaspa，由 Mazda 所造且聖潔
阿舍姆‧沃胡：聖潔是一切善事中最好的....
〔Give〕 賜予那人光榮與榮耀，賜予他健康的
身體，.... 賜予他光明、皆幸福、福樂的居所的
聖潔的眾者。
